reels.title: Reflex: Visually Grounded Reactive Humanoid Control

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper offers high visual storytelling potential and strong audience velocity due to the 'robotics' category. It allows for a dynamic animation focusing on 'reflex' vs 'planning', which mirrors human biological reactions.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: Why do robots have 'clumsy' movements, and how can we give them the near-instant reflexes of a pro athlete?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Catching a falling glass: explaining the difference between 'thinking' (deliberate planning) and 'reflex' (sub-conscious muscle response) using a split-screen animation.
